core_obligations: Relative glueing step: the local ring at the closed point of the limit is the colimit of the finite-level local rings; glueing data near the point correspond to compatible data at finite levels.
Limit of categories: the category of objects near the point is the colimit of the finite-level categories (fully faithful + essentially surjective both verified).
Formal combination: the equivalence statement follows by composing the two steps.
proof_roadmap: Local rings as colimits; glueing data compatibility.
Category colimit: FF and ES verifications.
difficulty_reason: Relative glueing + limit of categories + formal combination: three engines with a real limit-of-categories verification.
